name: Camp Laughing Loon
description_short: A non-profit summer day camp for ages 6 to 12 on Little Ossipee Lake in East Waterboro, Maine, running since 1917. Campers rotate through swimming lessons, canoeing, archery, arts and crafts, sports and nature or drama, with before and after care.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp sits on Little Ossipee Lake, with water on three sides. Campers have daily swimming and canoeing lessons from certified instructors, plus free swim in the afternoon.

source.title: Camp Laughing Loon - Maine Day Camp

refund_policy_summary: A $50 non-refundable deposit per week holds the spot, with the balance due May 31, 2027. Cancel at least 10 days before a week for a refund minus the deposit; within 10 days, tuition is not refunded.
